description: Explains the rooted cost baseline, right-view reuse, top-two exclusion maxima, whole weighted matching-deletion families, rectangular repair and the main/sub evaluation schedule. Derives Lemmas 12–14 and Theorem 15 with a numerical matching example and precise theorem-versus-source verification boundaries.

related_resources.reason: MFCS 2018 Sections 4–5, rooted Theorem 6 and Lemmas 12–14, Theorem 15, pp. 54:7–54:14.

learning_objectives: Derive the rooted O(nm Delta) matching bound using child-degree summation
Prove that maxima over all single-neighbor exclusions are obtained from top-two distinct-origin candidates
Explain matching-family reuse and the O(s^4+s^2t) rectangular deletion bound
Derive Lemmas 12–14 and Theorem 15 including the main/sub schedule and its conditional hypotheses
Distinguish the abstract cost proof from source-level correctness and resource proofs
